x: Derek Wade ran well on the first leg to record the good time of 8;4, and Yeo's 8:10 for an intermediate stage was equally noteworthy. Smith and Jarvis were our only two runners in the 'C' team, which consequently was unable to close in.

(U) For a second feature this proved a triumph for supporting guest stars Diprose, Smith & Donnison. Nurtured at the Belgrave breast was Pat O'Connor who will deservedly run away with an Oscar before he is much older.
What with these new names like Diprose, Smith, O'Connor and Mann running like bombs I shall be scared to show my face around the Hall, when I eventually save up the return fare'.
Bill Curtin was third fastest of the day and Davies of T.V.H. did 7.2 and Smith of Thurrock 7.4.

Canada's Mike Smith was always in the driving seat but it was very tight for the minor places. The two Australians Winter and Smith looked the most likely 2nd and 3rd placers and Simon was struggling with an ankle injury that was giving him great pain.
